Six-Country Hazard Atlas

Natural hazard atlas · 0.1° grid · demo

Ten perils scored 1 to 10. Each score bins a physical intensity measure at a fixed design return period, so a 7 for earthquake and a 7 for hail both mean a high intensity for that peril, not the same loss.

Demo surfacesEarthquake comes from the GEM Global Seismic Hazard Map 2023.1. The other nine perils are interpolated from terrain, river networks and general knowledge of the region where data is missing. Not for engineering, pricing or planning decisions.
